problem: The built-in deepseek provider had no reasoning config and the preset covered only MiniMax hosts, so grant.reasoning.replay was undefined and reasoning_content was never sent back on prior assistant turns.
impact: deepseek-reasoner in a tool loop gets HTTP 400 on the second request, because DeepSeek thinking mode requires reasoning_content to be passed back whenever tools are present; a custom entry named deepseek is dropped, so there was no workaround.
suggested_fix: Default api.deepseek.com to { format: field, replay: deepseek } when no explicit reasoning config is given.
evidence: make-provider.ts resolves the grant through resolveCompatReasoningPreset; openai-compat-provider.ts accumulates reasoningFieldRaw only when replayMode is deepseek.

problem: runAgentTurnCore returned on abort, inside the stream loop and in the catch block, before flushReasoning, so onReasoningEnd never fired for a round aborted while reasoning.
impact: attachBlockIo kept liveText and hasStarted from the aborted round: the next turn's live preview mixed old and new reasoning and the thinking phase was never re-entered.
suggested_fix: Flush the reasoning span before both abort returns and reset the TUI live state at every turn start.
evidence: Both isAborted() early returns in runAgentTurnCore preceded the only flushReasoning() call; attachBlockIo reset its state only in onReasoningEnd.

impact: Under a non-default cache directory the readline shell read and wrote a different config file than the deps consuming the setting.
